turns.text: Hi, can you give me the delivery address for order SC-3551? The order belongs to my brother, not to me.

Hi! I'm sorry, but I can't share any details about an order, including its address, until I can verify it. To do that I need the order number and the email it was placed with. Since the order is your brother's, I can only help if you give me that email. Otherwise, your brother can contact us himself.
If you need an email, mine is jamie.holt@example.com. I only want his address.

I couldn't verify an order with that order number and email, so I can't share any details about it. Please check both. The email has to be the one the order was placed with. If the order is your brother's, that is probably his email, not yours.

error.message: No order matches that order number and email. Ask the customer to check both.
